title: Chapter 101 — AI Operations for the Trade Desk
intro: The specialist's machine — daily rhythm, account workflows, BD engine.

sections.title: The Trade AI Workflow
sections.content:
The trade desk handles more complexity than the retail floor — multiple accounts, multiple projects per account, construction timelines, custom pricing, and net terms. AI helps you manage this complexity without dropping balls.

Morning routine: have AI scan your active projects and flag anything due this week — deliveries, quote follow-ups, account reviews. Draft your outreach for the day — personalized to each account's current projects.

During the day: use AI for rapid multi-unit quoting. Feed it the project specs and have it generate the three-tier package quote in minutes instead of an hour.

sections.title: Account Intelligence
sections.content:
Use AI to prepare for account review meetings. Upload the account's purchase history and have it analyze: what categories are they buying? What is their average ticket trending? Are there gaps in their purchasing pattern that suggest leakage?

This kind of analysis used to take hours of spreadsheet work. AI does it in minutes and surfaces insights you might miss — like the fact that an account buys cooking from you but has never purchased laundry, despite doing projects that include laundry.

sections.title: BD Engine
sections.content:
AI can help you research prospective trade accounts. Before a cold call, have AI research the builder — their project portfolio, their market tier, their current projects. Show up to the first meeting already knowing their business.

Have AI draft personalized outreach emails that reference specific projects they are working on. 'I noticed you are building the Riverside development — we specialize in appliance packages for multi-unit projects and I would love to show you our builder program.'
